title: Cylinder homotopy formula X(η₁) − X(η₀) = X(S_{dβ}) + ∂X(S_β), and X(η₁) − X(η₀) = X(S_{dβ}) in degree 0
statement: Assume (LOC): for all N, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) (GeometricCurrentOn univ k), η, η' ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) (TestFormOn univ k) and open W ⊆ ℝ^N with spt X ⊆ W and η(x) = η'(x) for all x ∈ W, one has X(η) = X(η'). This is the exact frozen type of the toolkit's (LOC) conjunct, written as an antecedent. Let ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)), e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, Jv := ι(0, v) and d := exteriorDerivative. (1) Degree k + 1. Let N, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N), β ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}), η₀, η₁ ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N) and let W be an open set with spt X ⊆ W. Suppose that for all x ∈ W and v ∈ (ℝ^N)^{k+1}, η₁(x)(v) = β(ι(1, x))(Jv_0, …, Jv_k) and η₀(x)(v) = β(ι(0, x))(Jv_0, …, Jv_k). Then there are η ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N) and θ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) such that η(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_0, …, Jv_k) dt for all x and v, θ(x)(u) = ∫_0^1 β(ι(t, x))(e₀, Ju_1, …, Ju_k) dt for all x and u, and X(η₁) − X(η₀) = X(η) + ∂X(θ). (2) Degree 0. Let N ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^N), β ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N+1}), η₀, η₁ ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^N) and let W be an open set with spt X ⊆ W, such that η₁(x)() = β(ι(1, x))() and η₀(x)() = β(ι(0, x))() for x ∈ W. Then there is η ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^N) with η(x)() = ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(e₀) dt for all x and X(η₁) − X(η₀) = X(η).
